Change Trigger (User Story V1 → V2): US-01 (Normalize+Capitalize): V1: Capitalize only. → V2: Normalize whitespace + remove accents + capitalize via facade.
US-02 (Title Case): V1: First letter only. → V2: Title-case every word with lowercasing remainder.
US-03 (Blank Detection): V1: Space-only blank check. → V2: Treat all ASCII whitespace (tabs/newlines) as blank.
US-04 (Wrap): V1: Wrap raw input. → V2: Normalize whitespace before wrapping and handle null safely.
US-05 (Smart Wrap): V1: Hard break at width. → V2: Prefer word boundary breaks and avoid empty lines.
US-06 (Reverse): V1: Reverse may off-by-one. → V2: Correct in-place reverse with null safety.
US-07 (Count Matches): V1: Non-overlapping counting. → V2: Count overlapping matches safely.
US-08 (Search Words): V1: Substring match. → V2: Case-insensitive search and whole-word containment.
US-09 (Numeric Parsing): V1: Fragile parsing. → V2: Trim + defaulting behavior for invalid inputs.
US-10 (Bounded Parse): V1: Parse only. → V2: Clamp to range and handle swapped bounds.
US-11 (Safe Identifier): V1: Basic check. → V2: Enforce ASCII printable and allowed character set.
US-12 (Text Analytics): V1: Simple counts. → V2: Normalize input and reuse search utilities for accurate metrics.
US-13 (Palindrome): V1: Exact match. → V2: Ignore accents/whitespace/case using shared utilities.
US-14 (Regex Utils): V1: Unsafe literal handling. → V2: Validate inputs and quote literals to avoid regex crashes.
US-15 (Word Utils): V1: Simplistic transformations. → V2: Swap-case per character and robust initials splitting.
